name: Kanban
excerpt: Kanban is a just-in-time approach to signal when tasks need to be done.
notes: Kanban is a scheduling system for lean and just-in-time production. It signals when tasks need to be done and is used to improve efficiency in project management.
context_summary:
- A scheduling system for lean production.
- Signals when tasks need to be done.
- Improves efficiency in project management.
